seo.title: CueBooker | Never lose the thread of a booking
seo.description: Capture calls, WhatsApps, emails and conversations in seconds. CueBooker keeps context, next moves, holds and your calendar together so no booking gets lost.

hero.eyebrow: OPERATIONAL MEMORY FOR DJS AND AGENCIES
hero.body: Someone calls. A WhatsApp arrives. An email changes the terms. You talk to someone at a venue. Capture it in seconds and CueBooker keeps the booking, what happened, what is next and the date under control.
proofs: Capture a conversation without changing channels
Every booking keeps its context and next move
Holds and confirmations share one calendar

problem.title: The conversation is scattered. The responsibility isn't.
problem.body: A booking can start with a phone call, continue on WhatsApp, change terms by email and close days later. The problem is not using several channels. The problem is remembering what happened, what is still pending and which date you committed to in each one.
problem.statement: CueBooker does not replace your channels. It stops context getting lost between them.

search.eyebrow: LATER · WHEN A REAL NETWORK EXISTS
search.title: Trajectory first. Discovery later.
search.body: Once real bookings, relationships and availability exist, CueBooker can add artist discovery without turning followers or popularity into a measure of value. The core remains the artist's real work and trajectory.
search.resultHint: Concept view of a future feature. Budget filters matches, but each DJ's fee remains private. Artists and results are fictional.

flow.eyebrow: FROM WHAT JUST HAPPENED TO WHAT HAPPENS NEXT
flow.title: One quick action. One thread that stays intact.
flow.body: CueBooker starts after the real-world interaction, not instead of it. Capture what matters, review what was understood and the booking stays connected to its history, next move and calendar.

steps.name: CUE
steps.detail: Write or dictate what just happened: a call, WhatsApp, email or conversation.

steps.name: Booking
steps.detail: CueBooker organises contact, venue or promoter, date, offer and source without forcing you to know everything yet.

steps.name: Activity
steps.detail: Every call, note, status change or movement stays attached to the same opportunity.

steps.name: Next Move
steps.detail: Keep one clear action visible: confirm schedule, wait for a reply, send a rider or whatever is next.

steps.name: Hold
steps.detail: Reserve a provisional date without pretending the booking is confirmed.

steps.name: Calendar
steps.detail: Holds, confirmed bookings and private availability coexist without duplicating the underlying data.

integrations.eyebrow: DON'T CHANGE HOW YOU TALK TO PEOPLE
integrations.title: Phone, WhatsApp, email and Instagram stay yours.
integrations.body: CueBooker does not force the promoter or DJ into another chat. Capture the important part when it happens and recover the context when you need it.

items.label: CAPTURE
items.name: Write or speak
items.body: Describe what just happened in your own words. CueBooker can separate channel, contact, date, offer and next move for you to review before saving.

items.label: FOLLOW-UP
items.name: Activity + Next Move
items.body: Log a call, note or message and keep the next action visible. You do not need to rebuild the conversation from memory.

items.label: SCHEDULE
items.name: Holds and confirmations
items.body: A provisional date remains a Hold. When the booking is confirmed, the calendar reflects the decision and closes incompatible holds.

integrations.note: Capture works without connecting any external account. Automatic email and channel integrations will be added behind adapters, without becoming a requirement for using CueBooker.

roles.eyebrow: LOW VOLUME OR HIGH, THE PROBLEM IS THE SAME
roles.title: Value from the first booking. More depth as the work grows.

items.name: Independent DJ
items.headline: Two gigs a month still deserve not to get lost.
items.body: When someone calls about a date, save it in seconds. CueBooker remembers who it was, what was discussed, what is missing and where it fits in your calendar.

items.name: Promoter or venue
items.headline: You do not need to learn another tool to talk to a DJ.
items.body: Keep using phone, email or the channels you already use. When you use the public form, the information enters the artist's same operational system already structured.

items.name: Manager or agency
items.headline: The same thread across your whole roster.
items.body: Each artist keeps bookings, holds and calendar context separated inside the workspace, with shared team access and permissions when needed.

access.eyebrow: THE WORKSPACE BELONGS TO THE ARTIST AND THEIR TEAM
access.title: Start simple. Structure appears when you need it.
access.body: A DJ can work alone inside one workspace. An agency uses the same core across several artists. A promoter does not have to adopt CueBooker for the DJ to keep proper follow-up.
access.demoNote: DJs and agencies can now create an account and enter the real Booking Core workspace.

demo.body: The workspace no longer depends on simulated requests to work. Demo data remains optional, while the primary flow uses the real Booking Core on staging.

Real inbox with search, filters, editing and status changes
Activity, Next Move, Holds and attention queue

demo.realNote: Future capabilities will build on the same Booking Core. AI will propose data; it will never become the source of truth or execute consequential changes without validation.

entry.title: Next time something happens, don't leave it in your head.
entry.body: Create your workspace and use + CUE to capture the next booking, even if all you know so far is who called and what remains pending.

feedback.title: We want to test it against the way you actually work.
feedback.body: If you are a DJ, manager, agency, promoter or venue, tell us how bookings reach you and what tends to get lost between one conversation and the next.
feedback.note: This form is for product testing and feedback. To use your private workspace, create an account.
